summary: SUB-04 usage journal and attribution for raw Ollama forwards

delivery.outcome: Every raw Ollama forward (POST /api/chat, /api/generate, /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions) records one usage attempt with provider=ollama, the model, application/function from X-Subactor-Application/Function (subactor-proxy/forward when absent), duration and token counts from prompt_eval_count/eval_count or usage (JSON, NDJSON final line, SSE); upstream errors are recorded with HTTP_<code>, UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT or UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE; no prompt or answer content is stored.
nonGoals: No change to routed (cloud) usage recording.
README is governance-owned; the usage panel already filters by provider.

architecture.decision: forward_usage_counts parses counts only; _record_forward writes through usage.record_attempt, which never raises.
interfaceChanges: usage journal rows for raw Ollama forwards (provider=ollama)
